milestones.title: 0.75.0 — reliability & enforcement
milestones.summary: The owner's four verbatim asks shipped together: the transient-API retry ladder (immediate → 1.5m → 5m → 10m → 30m → stop+notify, visible status card), hard task-mode enforcement (plan/review/explore read-only at the toolset level, owner-pinned, debug command tier, delegation inheritance), hover-only mode descriptions + read-only badges, and the single-row composer toolbar with the actually-working 5-line textarea. The deepest find: SDK error PARTS were swallowed — real 429s could never classify nor ladder; the adapter now re-throws them (live-verified).

current.title: R76 — the documentation round (accuracy & structure)
current.detail: The owner's ask: 'update the documentation… everything up to date and well managed… accurate and properly structured.' The audit found the truth docs had drifted behind the code: ORCHESTRATION-WORKLOG (the session history HANDOFF §1 points at) stopped at R67 — eight rounds (R68-R75) backfilled from the round files + git receipts, pure append +147 lines; AGENT-MEMORY stopped at lesson #71/R58 — five new lessons appended (72 drafts-above-published ordering, 73 the SDK error-PART channel, 74 the flex-1/height trap, 75 the stamp-cohort aging, 76 the interrupted-session re-verification pattern); ARCHITECTURE's crash-recovery section said the boot sweep marks sessions terminal failed (R75 changed it to the visible INTERRUPTED event + queued) and its module map predates the R75 modules — both fixed + the WS-gateway design note (SSE is the shipped surface); IMPLEMENTED-API refreshed R73→R75 (26 tools, /modes readOnly, the meta.retry frame, attempts on the error payloads, the ROUND-75 section); EXTENSIBILITY gained the R75 enforcement addendum; DESIGN-SYSTEM's composer anatomy was pre-R50 (rewritten: one-row @container + the 5-line autogrow); ROADMAP had been frozen at round-17 (refreshed to R75 reality); the docs index gained 5 unindexed runbooks + the ADR next-number truth; ADR-0026 (task-mode tool policy) + ADR-0027 (retry-ladder composition) written — the R75 decisions had never been recorded; MAINTENANCE recipe g gained the docs:check step 2b (the cohort-aging rule, also in DOC-STANDARDS §8); SECURITY gained the task-mode enforcement control; HANDOFF/AGENTS/SPEC/README model + transport + verify-chain truths fixed (REST+SSE, glm-5.2:free, 66e949a, ADRs 0001-0027). Two research agents: R76-a (the 20-item edit list, verified against code before flagging) + R76-b (the worklog backfill). Docs-only round: no code changes, no version bump (stays 0.75.0), no release.
